headline: Sensex slumps 900 points intraday as Nifty dips below 22,900 and India VIX surges 15%

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: BSE Sensex tumbled over 900 points and Nifty slipped below 22,900 in intraday trading.
Market volatility spiked sharply as India VIX surged 15%.
GIFT Nifty signaled a negative start while broader Asian markets traded mixed.
Expectations of RBI rate hikes of up to 50 bps by December weighed on market sentiment.
whatHappening: Sun Pharma acquired global rights targeting a $3.7 billion cholesterol drug market.
Indian consumer stocks have suffered an aggregate market value loss of ₹4 lakh crore in 2026.
Japanese bond yields advanced toward multi-decade highs on inflation and BOJ tightening bets.
A-One Steels IPO reached Day 3 subscribed 1.35 times with a gray market premium of 14%.
summary: Indian equities experienced a heavy sell-off on Monday as the Sensex dropped over 900 points and Nifty fell below 22,900. Market anxiety escalated with India VIX jumping 15% amid mixed Asian triggers and expectations of rate hikes by the RBI. In stock-specific news, Sun Pharma grabbed headlines after acquiring global rights to a $3.7 billion cholesterol drug market.
